papers.title: RESOURCE2SKILL: Distilling Executable Agent Skills from Human-Created Multimodal Resources
papers.abstract: Skills are a useful abstraction for software agents, turning human and agent experience into reusable procedural knowledge. Yet existing skill libraries are mostly hand-written, text-centric, or derived from agent traces, leaving tutorial videos...

papers.title: RAGU: A Multi-Step GraphRAG Engine with a Compact Domain-Adapted LLM
papers.abstract: Graph retrieval-augmented generation (GraphRAG) enhances large language models with structured knowledge, yet existing systems construct knowledge graphs in a single extraction pass, producing noisy entities and brittle retrieval. RAGU, an open-source...

papers.title: Xiaomi-Robotics-1: Scaling Vision-Language-Action Models with over 100K Hours of Real-World Trajectories
papers.abstract: We present Xiaomi-Robotics-1, a foundational VLA model capable of following diverse language instructions to perform a wide range of mobile manipulation tasks in unseen environments out-of-the-box, and efficiently adapting...

papers.title: xHC: Expanded Hyper-Connections
papers.abstract: Hyper-Connections (HC) expand the residual stream of Transformers into N parallel streams, providing a form of memory scaling beyond model width and depth. Manifold-Constrained HC (mHC) stabilizes this formulation at scale.

papers.title: On-Policy Delta Distillation
papers.abstract: On-policy distillation is an alternative post-training method in reinforcement learning that alleviates the constraints imposed by reward models by providing token-level supervision from a teacher model.

papers.title: When Does Muon Help Agentic Reinforcement Learning?
papers.abstract: Muon is competitive with AdamW in large-scale pre-training, but its value for reinforcement-learning (RL) post-training remains unclear. We study vanilla Muon in sparse-reward agentic RL through matched single-seed comparisons with AdamW on ALFWorld...

papers.title: Recursive Harness Self-Improvement
papers.abstract: Under model-harness co-evolution, harnesses are not merely inference-time scaffolds but data-generating components whose execution traces can shape future foundation models.

papers.title: Qwen-Music Technical Report
papers.abstract: We introduce Qwen-Music, a powerful music generation model capable of producing highly musical and high-fidelity songs with complete vocal singing. Supports Text to Music Generation and other core tasks.

papers.title: S1-Omni: A Unified Multimodal Reasoning Model for Scientific Understanding, Prediction, and Generation
papers.abstract: We present S1-Omni, a unified multimodal reasoning model for scientific understanding, prediction, and generation. AI for Science (AI4S) has advanced significantly through domain-specific models, tool-augmented LLMs.

papers.title: VideoRAE: Taming Video Foundation Models for Generative Modeling via Representation Autoencoders
papers.abstract: Video generative models commonly rely on latent spaces learned by 3D Variational Autoencoders (3D-VAEs). However, conventional 3D-VAEs are mainly optimized for pixel-level reconstruction, limiting semantic structure.

cc_updates.body: Claude no longer runs the `/verify` and `/code-review` skills on its own; invoke them with `/verify` or `/code-review` when you want them

Fixed single-segment `dir/**` allow rules like `Edit(src/**)` auto-approving writes to nested `dir/` directories anywhere in the tree instead of only `<cwd>/dir`. Fixed a permission-check bypass affecting commands run in Windows PowerShell 5.1 sessions. Fixed Bash permission checks to fail closed on file-descriptor redirect forms. Added the EndConversation tool for handling abusive users. Added periodic progress heartbeat for long-running tool calls. Added ISO `modified` timestamp to memory file frontmatter. Improved auto mode, fixed various crashes and hangs, and improved agent view rendering.

`/fork` now copies your conversation into a new background session while you keep working; the in-session subagent is now `/subtask`. Added `claude auto-mode reset` command. Added session-wide limit on WebSearch tool calls (default 200). MCP tool calls over 2 minutes now move to background automatically. Fixed plan mode auto-running file-modifying commands without permission prompts. Fixed worktree creation following symlinks. Improved background agent attach and result reporting.
